report_completeness_gaps.severity: required_before_final_mechanism_claim; not a blocker to optimization
report_completeness_gaps.finding: Reference runner and smoke log gradients of FM+A+R total loss. Reference runner does not call auxiliary_audit, feature_statistics, retrieval or relation validation diagnostics. Therefore reference-model records alone do not isolate A/R gradients reaching generator or provide on/off shared-feature variance/rank/correspondence evidence.
report_completeness_gaps.next_action: Use independent zero-update post-training evaluation of own reference checkpoints for Align/Relation/Both; run auxiliary-only (A/R as appropriate) backward and frozen/finite group audits with HRI on/off; record fixed-val oracle-noised-HR alignment/relation, variance/effective rank and correspondence diagnostics per mode. Keep these explicitly separate from LR-only recovery; no optimizer update or test-set tuning. Do not silently call no-ref auxiliary_audit and describe it as HRI-on diagnostic.

Update GPU-hours omit these costs. Internal sampler/decode times are cached-latent timing, without reference encode/full restore peak.

Or capture exact service/journal boundaries separately and label missing subphase costs. Full pixel-to-pixel inference time/peak can be measured by already implemented frozen_evaluation/native restore; do not relabel cached-latent sample/decode time as end-to-end.
